# BlitzBasic: Drawing

Colors, shapes, text positioning and the viewport.

Back to [[BlitzBasic]] or the [[Command-Index]].

| Command | Returns | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| [Cls](BlitzBasic-Drawing#cls) | None | Clears the current buffer with the color set by [ClsColor](BlitzBasic-Drawing#clscolor). |
| [ClsColor](BlitzBasic-Drawing#clscolor) | None | Sets the color that [Cls](BlitzBasic-Drawing#cls) clears with. |
| [Color](BlitzBasic-Drawing#color) | None | Sets the color that `Plot`, `Line`, `Rect`, `Oval` and `Text` draw with. |
| [ColorBlue](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorblue) | Int |  |
| [ColorGreen](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorgreen) | Int |  |
| [ColorRed](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorred) | Int |  |
| [GetColor](BlitzBasic-Drawing#getcolor) | None | Reads the pixel at a position of the current buffer and makes it the drawing color. |
| [Line](BlitzBasic-Drawing#line) | None | Draws a line between two points. |
| [Origin](BlitzBasic-Drawing#origin) | None | Moves the point that counts as 0, 0 for everything you draw after it. |
| [Oval](BlitzBasic-Drawing#oval) | None | Draws an ellipse inside the box given by position and size. |
| [Plot](BlitzBasic-Drawing#plot) | None | Draws a single pixel in the drawing color. |
| [Rect](BlitzBasic-Drawing#rect) | None | Draws a rectangle. |
| [ScanLine](BlitzBasic-Drawing#scanline) | Int |  |
| [Viewport](BlitzBasic-Drawing#viewport) | None | Limits all drawing to a part of the buffer. |

### Cls

```blitzbasic
Cls
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Clears the current buffer with the color set by [ClsColor](BlitzBasic-Drawing#clscolor). Call it at the start of every frame when you redraw the whole picture.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
ClsColor 40, 90, 160
Cls
Color 255, 255, 255
Text 160, 120, "Cls cleared this to blue", 1, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Cls](media/drawing/cls.png)

### ClsColor

```blitzbasic
ClsColor red%, green%, blue%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Sets the color that [Cls](BlitzBasic-Drawing#cls) clears with. It does not change the drawing color of [Color](BlitzBasic-Drawing#color). Values are clamped to 0 through 255.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | Int | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | Int | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | Int | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

### Color

```blitzbasic
Color red%, green%, blue%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Sets the color that `Plot`, `Line`, `Rect`, `Oval` and `Text` draw with.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 7
	Color i * 36, 255 - i * 36, 128
	Rect 10 + i * 38, 80, 30, 80, 1
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Color](media/drawing/color.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `red` | Int | required | Red part, 0 to 255. |
| `green` | Int | required | Green part, 0 to 255. |
| `blue` | Int | required | Blue part, 0 to 255. |

### GetColor

```blitzbasic
GetColor x%, y%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Reads the pixel at a position of the current buffer and makes it the drawing color. Use [ColorRed](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorred), [ColorGreen](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorgreen) and [ColorBlue](BlitzBasic-Drawing#colorblue) afterwards to see what it was.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | Int | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |

### Line

```blitzbasic
Line x1%, y1%, x2%, y2%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Draws a line between two points. Both end points are drawn, and the line is made of whole pixels like in the original.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
For i = 0 To 319 Step 16
	Color i * 255 / 319, 160, 255 - i * 255 / 319
	Line 160, 0, i, 239
Next
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Line](media/drawing/line.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x1` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the start. |
| `y1` | Int | required | Vertical position of the start. |
| `x2` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the end. |
| `y2` | Int | required | Vertical position of the end. |

### Origin

```blitzbasic
Origin x%, y%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Moves the point that counts as 0, 0 for everything you draw after it. Shapes, text and images move with it, the viewport does not.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 80, 80
Rect 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Origin 160, 120
Color 80, 255, 80
Rect 0, 0, 40, 40, 1
Color 255, 255, 255
Line -100, 0, 100, 0
Line 0, -100, 0, 100
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Origin](media/drawing/origin.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the new origin in the buffer. |
| `y` | Int | required | Vertical position of the new origin in the buffer. |

### Oval

```blitzbasic
Oval x%, y%, width%, height%, solid%=1
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Draws an ellipse inside the box given by position and size.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 255, 200, 0
Oval 20, 20, 120, 120, 1
Color 0, 200, 255
Oval 170, 40, 130, 80, 0
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Oval](media/drawing/oval.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the left side of the box. |
| `y` | Int | required | Vertical position of the top of the box. |
| `width` | Int | required | Width of the box. |
| `height` | Int | required | Height of the box. |
| `solid` | Int | `1` | 1 fills the ellipse, 0 draws only its outline. Defaults to 1. |

### Plot

```blitzbasic
Plot x%, y%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Draws a single pixel in the drawing color.

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the pixel. |
| `y` | Int | required | Vertical position of the pixel. |

### Rect

```blitzbasic
Rect x%, y%, width%, height%, solid%=1
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Draws a rectangle.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
For frame = 0 To 59
	Cls
	Color 255, 255, 255
	Rect 20, 20, 280, 200, 0
	Color 255, 160, 0
	Rect 30 + frame * 3, 90, 40, 60, 1
	Flip
Next
```

![Rect](media/drawing/rect.gif)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the left side. |
| `y` | Int | required | Vertical position of the top. |
| `width` | Int | required | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | Int | required | Height in pixels. |
| `solid` | Int | `1` | 1 fills the rectangle, 0 draws only the outline. Defaults to 1. |

### ScanLine

```blitzbasic
ScanLine  ; returns Int
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

_Not documented yet._

**Returns:** Always 0. The original returned the line the monitor was drawing, which a modern display cannot tell.

**Differences and known gaps:**

* Always returns 0. Use `VWait` or `Flip` to synchronise with the display instead.

### Viewport

```blitzbasic
Viewport x%, y%, width%, height%
```

**Works in:** Blitz2D, BlitzPlus, Blitz3D

Limits all drawing to a part of the buffer. Anything outside it is cut off, and [Cls](BlitzBasic-Drawing#cls) only clears the inside. The part that sticks out of the buffer is cut off as well. Call `Viewport 0, 0, GraphicsWidth(), GraphicsHeight()` to reset it.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Cls
Color 60, 60, 60
Rect 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
Viewport 60, 60, 200, 120
Color 255, 120, 0
Oval 0, 0, 320, 240, 1
Flip
WaitKey
```

![Viewport](media/drawing/viewport.png)

| Parameter | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `x` | Int | required | Horizontal position of the left side of the viewport. |
| `y` | Int | required | Vertical position of the top of the viewport. |
| `width` | Int | required | Width in pixels. |
| `height` | Int | required | Height in pixels. |
